title: InstantSimCleanup
description: InstantSimCleanup is a forced server optimization plugin that reduces lag by aggressively clearing inactive zones. Instead of relying on a standard timer, it uses a chunk distance control mechanic to remove everything in areas where there are no players.
body:
InstantSimCleanup is a forced server optimization plugin that reduces lag by aggressively clearing inactive zones. Instead of relying on a standard timer, it uses a chunk distance control mechanic to remove everything in areas where there are no players.

How it works:
Out-of-bound chunk clearing: The plugin instantly removes absolutely all items and unnecessary entities that are located further than the chunk radius specified in the config (outside the active gameplay zone).

Zero chat spam: The clearing process happens automatically and silently, without any annoying countdowns or chat warnings.

Safe for important mobs: The system completely ignores and will NOT clear passive (domestic) animals, as well as any mobs named with a Name Tag.
